Log in and upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per the specified format.
Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully and accurately.
Pay the applicable application fee/intimation charges online.
Click "Complete Registration" and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee e-receipt for future reference.

important_instructions: Candidates can apply for only one state; a candidate applying for one state's vacancy is not eligible to apply for any other state. Selected candidates will be posted within the applied state for the first 12 years of service or until promotion to SMGS-IV, whichever is earlier. Candidates working in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU roles must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of Personal Interview.

content_sections.heading: IOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026-27 Overview

rows.details: Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Gujarat (state applied for)

content_sections.heading: IOB Local Bank Officer Important Dates
content_sections.text: The exact dates for the online examination and the Language Proficiency Test / Personal Interview are not specified in the notification. IOB will issue call letters and further details on its official website.

rows.activity: Payment of Application Fee / Intimation Charges

content_sections.heading: IOB LBO Vacancy 2026-27: State-wise Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The 250 vacancies are distributed across four states, and candidates must apply for only one state. Merit lists will be prepared state-wise and category-wise. Category-wise reservation (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR) and the PwBD sub-quota (VI/HI/OC/ID) for each state are given in the detailed notification. Some state vacancies include backlog posts, and the number of vacancies, including reserved vacancies, is provisional and may vary according to the Bank's actual requirement.

content_sections.heading: IOB Local Bank Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026-27
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for the vacancy of only one state and must fulfil the eligibility criteria specified for that state, including the mandatory local language proficiency. A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of settling permanently, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, East African countries (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia) or Vietnam with the intention of settling permanently in India, subject to the required eligibility certificate from the Government of India. Candidates must hold a Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized university or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government. Candidates must possess a valid mark-sheet/degree certificate showing they are a graduate on the day they register, and must indicate their graduation percentage while registering online.

content_sections.heading: IOB Local Bank Officer Age Limit 2026-27
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for age and educational qualification eligibility is 01.08.2026 (the first day of the month in which online registration commences). Candidates must have been born not later than 01.08.2006 and not earlier than 02.08.1996 (both dates inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General category and EWS candidates. Cumulative age relaxation across categories is available to SC/ST/OBC candidates, subject to a maximum upper age limit of 50 years, and is available only when the candidate meets the conditions prescribed in the relevant Government of India guidelines. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

rows.category: Ex-servicemen/Commissioned Officers (with at least 5 years military service)

content_sections.heading: IOB Local Bank Officer Application Fee 2026-27
content_sections.text: The fee is payable online via Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, or UPI/BHIM. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment process, even if the application is not completed.

content_sections.heading: IOB Local Bank Officer Salary 2026-27
content_sections.text: In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will receive DA, HRA, CCA and other allowances as per Bank rules in force from time to time. One advance increment (maximum of two) may be granted for prior completed years of service as an Officer in a Scheduled Commercial Bank, subject to the candidate's job profile matching that of a Scale-I Generalist Officer, and subject to submission of a certified job profile from their existing/previous employer.

content_sections.heading: IOB Local Bank Officer Selection Process 2026-27
content_sections.text: Selection is made through an Online Examination, followed by a Language Proficiency Test (LPT) for candidates who have not studied the applied state's local language in Std. X or Std. XII, and a Personal Interview. There is a penalty of 0.25 marks for each wrong answer, with no penalty for unattempted questions. There is no sectional cut-off, but the minimum qualifying aggregate is 30% for reserved category candidates and 35% for unreserved candidates. Candidates shortlisted for the Personal Interview who have not studied the applied state's local language in Std. X or Std. XII must qualify an LPT before the interview. Candidates who fail the LPT will not proceed further in the selection process. The Personal Interview carries 100 marks. The minimum qualifying marks are 45% for reserved category candidates and 50% for unreserved candidates. The weightage of Online Examination and Personal Interview is in the ratio of 80:20. The minimum aggregate score (Online Exam + Interview) required is 30% for reserved categories and 35% for unreserved category candidates. The final merit list is prepared state-wise and category-wise.

content_sections.heading: Probation and Bond
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years of active service from the date of joining. They must execute a Financial Service Indemnity Bond of ₹2,00,000 for rendering a minimum of 3 years of service.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026-27
content_sections.text: Visit the official IOB website, www.iob.bank.in, and open the "Careers" page. Click on "Recruitment of Local Bank Officers – 2026-27" and select the post to apply. Click "Click here to Register Online" and complete first-time registration. Note the system-generated Registration Number and Password sent by email/SMS. Log in and upload photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration as per the specified format. Fill in all required details in the online application form carefully and accurately. Pay the applicable application fee/intimation charges online. Click "Complete Registration" and take a printout of the submitted application form and fee e-receipt for future reference. Applications can be submitted only online from 08.08.2026 to 24.08.2026. No other mode of application is accepted, and applications once submitted cannot be withdrawn.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for only one state; a candidate applying for one state's vacancy is not eligible to apply for any other state. Selected candidates will be posted within the applied state for the first 12 years of service or until promotion to SMGS-IV, whichever is earlier. Application Fee/Intimation charges, once paid, are non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment process. If multiple applications are submitted for the same state, only the last submitted application will be considered. Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted as valid photo ID proof. Request for change of examination centre, Personal Interview date, or centre will not be entertained. Candidates working in Government/Quasi-Government/PSU roles must produce a No Objection Certificate at the time of Personal Interview.

content_sections.heading: IOB LBO Examination Centres
content_sections.text: The online examination will be conducted at various centres across India, including Chennai, Madurai, Coimbatore, Tiruchirappalli in Tamil Nadu; Bengaluru, Hubli-Dharwad, Mysuru in Karnataka; Mumbai/Thane/Navi Mumbai, Pune, Nagpur in Maharashtra; and Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar, Surat, Rajkot in Gujarat, among other centres nationwide. The Bank reserves the right to add, delete, or reassign examination centres based on response and administrative feasibility. faq.question: Q1. What is IOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is Indian Overseas Bank's recruitment drive (Advt. No. HRDD/RECT/02/2026-27) for 250 Local Bank Officer posts in the JMGS-I cadre across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, and Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IOB LBO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 250 vacancies in total: 100 in Tamil Nadu, 50 in Karnataka, 50 in Maharashtra, and 50 in Gujarat.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IOB LBO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: A Degree (Graduation) in any discipline from a recognized university is required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 20 and 30 years of age as on the cut-off date of 01.08.2026, with age relaxation applicable for reserved categories as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IOB LBO Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: ₹175 (inclusive of GST) for SC/ST/PwBD candidates, and ₹850 (inclusive of GST) for General/EWS/OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for IOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through www.iob.bank.in under the "Careers" section from 8 August 2026 to 24 August 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IOB Local Bank Officer Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Selection is through an Online Examination, a Language Proficiency Test (where applicable), and a Personal Interview, with a final weightage of 80:20 between the Online Examination and the Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for IOB Local Bank Officer 2026-27?
faq.answer: The basic pay scale is ₹48480-2000/7-62480-2340/2-67160-2680/7-85920 in JMGS-I, plus DA, HRA, CCA and other allowances as per Bank rules.
